director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter padhenge—cricket ground ki boundary jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ek lamba rectangle hoti hai, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Pitch ke ek kone se chalna shuru karo, kinaare-kinaare chalo aur wapas usi kone par pahuncho, toh jitni doori tay hui, wahi pitch ka parimap hai. Achha, Riya.

Ek kone se chalo aur wapas usi kone par aao. Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain: 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone se chalo, teeno bhujaon se hote hue wapas usi kone par aao. Yeh poora raasta hi triangle ka parimap hai. Toh is triangle ka parimap kitna hai?

director.text: 9 cm

Label sirf ek bhuja par hai, 5 cm. Baaki bhujaon par kuch likha nahi hai, phir bhi woh kinaare ka hissa hain. Parimap mein har bhuja ki lambai judti hai. Toh is hexagon ka parimap kitna hai?

mujhe lagta hai haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Baad kinaare par lagti hai, toh teeno bhujayein jodo: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki koi bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad adhoori reh jaayegi. Yahan tak theek hai?

haan
Ab teesri bhuja, 12 m, bhi jodo. 16 m mein 12 m jodkar kitna hua?
